scope: Eight primary artifact/workspace modules plus nested document, processing, live preview and runtime-health views. TerminalSurface is preserved and mapped to real xterm local-session/execution scenes.
fixtures: Production React components with deterministic, explicitly synthetic host state. No real user file, provider invocation or Android-native acceptance claim.

existing_node_tests.core_assertions_preserved: Local input tests explicitly expand the new input disclosure; media source-identity tests explicitly expand the new source disclosure. All original handle, draft, bounds, Back, once-only and unknown-result assertions retained.

real_media_lifecycle.boundary: Real Chromium synthetic WAV/WebM files, actual playback/seek/mute/pause/pagehide/unmount; not Android source pinning

verification.screenshot_arrival_gate: Every final after capture waits for its unique production heading/input/object/viewport/xterm target, confirms no hidden/aria-hidden/inert ancestor, then waits for document.fonts.ready and two requestAnimationFrame frames. Images also wait for a completed nonzero naturalWidth.

follow_up_node_tests.note: Overlaps the primary 66 tests; counts are not additive. Existing authority/handle, once-only, Back and unknown-result assertions retained.

terminal_mapping.decision: Actual xterm output is already the focal object. Retained unchanged, including renderer ACK/input/lifecycle guards. Screenshot arrival requires its real .xterm-screen.

verification.media_task_follow_up: The existing top-right new-creation action is ghost only while reading a task; the same creation entry remains reachable. Saved task artifacts remain the focal content. Fresh captures use the same fixture task.
